findings: ROOT CAUSE confirmed at combat-bridge.js:72 — `if (e.utility_class === null || e.geometry !== 'none') dmg += outputOf(...)`. That predicate is true for every effect with geometry, i.e. every enemy-side effect. Now closed over DAMAGE_EFFECTS (5) only.

The build had NO quest runtime: QuestBook/FactionGates/QuestEngine (1155 lines, complete) were never instantiated and game/data/quests/hooks.json never existed. That is why AR-2 B7 was not_run and RI-MAG04 M6=0/M7=0. Now instantiated at engine._boot.
QuestEngine.context() gated `requires.spell_effects` on magic.knownEffects (a spell you OWN). Changed to magic.castEffects (an effect you have actually CAST) — RI-MAG06's premise applied to the gate.

No S11 buildup meter existed anywhere in game/src (grep 'buildup' -> 2 hits, both comments). Added BUILDUP in magic/apply.js with per-kind integer thresholds; paralyse is magnitude x4 per contact against a threshold of 100, so the cheapest paralyse spell needs 3 contacts and 0->applied-in-one-frame is structurally impossible.

No mitigation path existed: resolve.js computed damage and applied it with no multiplier. Added mitigate(B, dmg) at the single site damage is computed, consuming body.mitigation, body.armourRating and body.wardCharges.

Levitation: altitude was a counter with a Focus tax; pos[1] was never written. stepLevitation now assigns b.pos[1] = groundY + altitude, and a new _levitationLocomotion branch in combat/player.js caps drift at the declared 1.4 m/s with no sprint/jog ladder. _tryStart drops the five denied buttons from cast-classes.json §levitation.airborne_denies.
Projectile tracking measured 0.000 deg/s because _spawnProjectile never set p.target. Now acquires a body already inside a 20-degree release cone and stops dead at cutoffF.
Data loader keys game/data/quests/* by doc.id, not filename: hooks.json -> data.quests['quest-hooks'], magic-utility.json -> data.quests['magic-utility-quests'].
api-probe 33/33 PASS with all of the above wired.

CONCURRENT-AGENT HAZARD: other agents commit the whole worktree (commit 1c1f98b picked up my in-flight files) and left engine.js referencing a missing _censusStep. I added a defensive `this._censusStep ? ... : null` guard on that line.
MEASURED at HEAD: EFFECT-FUNCTION 55/55, HP_DAMAGE_ONLY 0, UNREAD_TIMER 0, PARTIAL 0, NOT_OBSERVED 0, GENERIC-APPLICATOR 0/55. RI-MAG06 bar is >=50/55 with HP_DAMAGE_ONLY 0 and UNREAD_TIMER <=2.

LEVITATION measured: pos[1] peak 6.12 m at altitude_m 6.12 (the two are the same number by assignment), 1.500 Focus/m, drift 1.388 m/s against a 1.4 cap and a measured walk of 3.173 m/s, state AIRBORNE throughout, light/heavy/block/roll/parry ALL dropped, iframe false on every frame.
SLOWFALL measured: terminal 3.5 m/s and 0 fall damage from 30 m, against a control of 18 m/s and 144 damage.
PARALYSE measured: buildup 36/59/82 over three contacts, procs on the fourth, enemy state PARALYSED. Never 0 -> applied in one frame.
MITIGATION measured: an identical scripted 100-damage hit takes 100 unbuffed, 53.68 with shield, 30.52 with resist_element.
CONTROL VERBS measured: calm_beast/demoralise/charm all end with hp_fall 0, deaths 0, yielded true, in_combat FALSE. charm also moves disposition. frenzy changes the target with 0 deaths.
SOUL_TRAP measured: gems 0 at cast, 1 after the target's death; xul_hesh 0 -> 1. Fills on death, not on cast.
FEATHER measured: 34% MEDIUM -> 0% LIGHT, crossing RI-CMB01 M5's 30.00 cliff, which does not move.

BUG WORTH REMEMBERING: MagicSystem._emit(frame, kind, fields) spreads `fields`, so a field literally named `kind` overwrites the event type. addBuildup emitted {kind:'fire'} instead of {kind:'status_buildup'} and the meter was invisible to every consumer. Renamed to status_kind.

BUG WORTH REMEMBERING: SimState.reset() replaces sim.quest wholesale, so a QuestEngine built at boot keeps writing into the PREVIOUS journal array after any loadState(). Engine._rebindQuestRuntime() fixes it; hist_sight measured UNREAD_TIMER purely because of this.
RI-MAG04 MEASURED: M6 10/10 magic resolutions played through end to end (of 24 in the book); M7 7/7 AR-3 crossings X1..X7 demonstrated in play.

ECONOMY MEASURED: 49 purchasable spells = 20,754 g + 13 priced enchanting services = 9,046 g -> MAGIC LINE 29,800 g against RI-MAG03 M8's 28,000 +/-15% band [23,800..32,200]. Deviation +6.43%, inside the tighter +/-10% band too.

Three spells cost more Focus than the maximum reachable pool of 124 (call_the_deep_drowned 185, the_still_water 594, the_long_stillness 156). Retuned in gen-spells.mjs; 0 uncastable shelf spells remain, so bind_greater has a carrier.

cure_paralysis's only carrier was range `touch` — a contact spell with no body in front of it resolves on nothing, so the spell you cast to unfreeze YOURSELF could only be cast on somebody else. Added a `self` carrier and kept the touch one.

geometryOf placed a `target`-range AREA spell's volume at the CASTER. wamasu_arc (3 m shock burst) therefore did 0 damage to two bodies 6 m away. Fixed in both gen-spells.mjs and MagicSystem._geometryFor: only self/touch areas are centred on the caster.

Spell geometry only ever tested creature bodies, so `open` cast at a door with nobody in front of it did nothing. MagicSystem.step now sweeps projectiles and volumes against the lock/trap/breakable registers too — GATED on the spell carrying a world verb, so a fireball is not eaten by a door.

VFX MEASURED: draw-call series is now idle 21 / release 23 / inflight 23 / residue+20s 22 against the round-1 verdict's flat 8/8/8/8. At release: 3 distinct particle systems (floor 3), 356 particles (ceiling 900), 4 particle draw calls (ceiling 6), 1 residue decal (floor 1). VFX-LIT is visibly demonstrated: non-emissive particles are dramatically dimmer at midnight while the emissive core holds.

V7 (motion vectors for TAA) is the ONE F-M1 row absent and is declared absent in featureReport(): this renderer has no temporal pass to feed. 9 of 10 with V1/V2/V4 (the three mandatory rows) all present.
faction-gates.json did not exist; QuestEngine needs it. Generated for the 9 factions the quest book actually references, 8 ranks each, RI-QST03 §B four-part statement, no level/souls/gold gates.

Three magic resolutions declared `requires.knowledge` keys that NOTHING could reveal (decorative gates, RI-JRN07 M-Q14 hard fail). gen-quest-knowledge.mjs gives each an actual door, magic and mundane, so Q8's no-lockout rule holds.

REGRESSIONS GREEN: api-probe 33/33, mag-probe 19/19 (incl. AR3_X1 and AR3_X4), save-audit round-trip EQUAL on all 4 states with manifest-extra 0/0, lint-determinism 0 errors, determinism ladder 7/9 (unchanged from before this round).
notes_for_successor: The registry in game/src/sim/magic/apply.js is checked for completeness at boot (assertRegistryComplete): a catalogue effect with no handler throws rather than falling through to a damage number. DAMAGE_EFFECTS is the frozen 5-element set shared by apply.js and combat-bridge.js so the two cannot drift.
